description: This file defines the LuckyUserService class which manages logic for selecting users based on booking history, calendar availability, and attribute weights within a scheduling or booking system. It includes methods for fetching calendar and booking data, filtering users, and generating ordered lists of 'lucky' users for scheduling purposes.

classes.name: LuckyUserService
classes.description: Service class implementing user selection logic based on booking history, calendar availability, and attribute weights for scheduling.

methods.name: getLuckyUser
methods.description: Main method to determine a 'lucky' user based on provided parameters, fetching necessary data and applying filtering logic.

methods.name: getLuckyUser_requiresDataToBePreFetched
methods.description: Determines the lucky user using pre-fetched data, applying weight and priority filters, and selecting based on booking recency.

methods.name: prepareQueuesAndAttributesData
methods.description: Prepares attribute weights and virtual queue data based on routing form responses and user attributes.

methods.name: getOrderedListOfLuckyUsers
methods.description: Generates an ordered list of users ranked by their suitability for scheduling, considering booking history and other filters.

methods.name: fetchAllDataNeededForCalculations
methods.description: Fetches calendar, booking, and user data required for user selection calculations.

methods.name: getCalendarBusyTimesOfInterval
methods.description: Retrieves busy times from users' calendars within a specified interval.

methods.name: getBookingsOfInterval
methods.description: Fetches bookings within a specified interval for given users.

methods.name: leastRecentlyBookedUser
methods.description: Selects the user who was booked least recently from a list of available users.

methods.name: getHostsWithCalibration
methods.description: Calculates calibration scores for hosts based on their booking history and OOO entries.

methods.name: getUsersWithHighestPriority
methods.description: Filters available users to those with the highest priority.

methods.name: filterUsersBasedOnWeights
methods.description: Filters users based on attribute weights and booking shortfalls.

methods.name: getAverageAttributeWeights
methods.description: Calculates average weights for hosts based on attribute query values.

methods.name: getAttributesForVirtualQueues
methods.description: Extracts attribute options related to virtual queues from form responses.

methods.name: getQueueAndAttributeWeightData
methods.description: Fetches and computes attribute weights and virtual queue data based on routing form responses.
